full.description: This is a micrograph showing a section of renal tissue. The image displays evidence of tubular injury, characterized by outlines of tubules with intense eosinophilic cytoplasm and cellular debris. The features are consistent with renal infarction or ischemic tubular necrosis, marking the interface between viable and affected non-viable areas.

blind.description: This image is a photomicrograph of renal tissue showing features of acute tubular injury or infarction. The affected area displays tubular cells with intensely eosinophilic cytoplasm, pyknotic nuclei, and granular debris within the lumen. The overall architecture maintains the outlines of tubules near the interface between viable and non-viable regions. These findings are characteristic of ischemic or toxic tubular necrosis.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of kidney tissue showing advanced chronic changes, including marked tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis. The remaining renal tubules contain dense, homogenous proteinaceous casts, resembling thyroidization of the kidney. A glomerulus is visible with associated surrounding interstitial inflammation and scarring. These findings are characteristic of chronic tubulointerstitial nephritis.
